first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the 4% completion decline and may also recover activation, with prior evidence of durable early-adoption gains. Verify memory_86 to confirm downstream quality and durability, and memory_73 to assess whether promotional pricing would generate sustainable qualified revenue rather than primarily short-term acquisition under competitive pressure.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening the onboarding flow. The verified source shows completion +13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%, directly addressing the current onboarding and activation declines while supporting sustainable revenue. Reject promotional pricing despite competitive pressure because its verified cohort had 30-day retention down 12% and failed to survive the first renewal cycle.
